chefStory.heading: The Chef's Story
chefStory.imageAlt: The Home's Chef Owner kneading pizza dough
paragraphs: With many years immersed in the world of Italian and European cuisine, The Home's Chef Owner spent years experiencing hundreds of pizza flavors around the world. Every country tells its own story through this familiar dish. But throughout that journey, he kept asking himself: why does Vietnam, with its rich and diverse cuisine stretching from north to south, still not have a pizza that carries the true soul of Vietnam?

From that question, the dream of a Vietnamese Specialty Pizza began — a pizza combining Western craftsmanship with homegrown ingredients: from rich H'mong duck meat to sweet Rạch Vẹm shrimp, to the distinctive herbs of Vietnam's S-shaped land. That dream was nurtured in The Home's kitchen, where the Chef Owner and his fellow chefs came together, sharing their love for Vietnamese flavors and their respect for every ingredient.
At The Home, every pizza that comes out of the oven isn't just a dish — it's The Home's way of telling the story of Vietnamese flavor in a new language.

peopleStory.heading: The People's Story
peopleStory.imageAlt: A member of The Home serving guests at the restaurant
paragraphs: The Home believes that genuine connection begins with the smallest things: a warm greeting, a thoughtful gesture, or the feeling of being truly cared for. The people of The Home carry kindness into every small moment, so that each time you visit, you're not just looking for a meal — you're coming home to somewhere familiar.

The Home's creative spirit doesn't just live in the kitchen — it shows up in how guests are served, too. Drawing inspiration from Vietnamese cuisine spanning the North, Central, South, and Phu Quoc, the people of The Home are always ready to tell you the story behind every dish and every ingredient, so you feel closer to Vietnamese flavor on a traditional Italian pizza base.
At The Home, everything is cared for just enough so you can sit back, enjoy your meal, and talk freely — just like you would at home.

ket-noi.label: Connection
ket-noi.paragraph: Grounded in the finest essence of Vietnamese cuisine spanning north to south, and inspired by the art of traditional Italian pizza-making, The Home never stops exploring and innovating in every recipe — so each pizza is a refined fusion of Vietnamese specialties and classic pizza craft, delivering a unique, bold, and deeply proud taste experience.

sang-tao.label: Creativity
sang-tao.paragraph: The Home wants to build a genuine connection between The Home Pizza and its guests, rooted in the kindness of The Home's own people — its true companions. From there, the spirit and values of Home spread to every team member, so every guest can feel it too.

tan-tam.label: Dedication
tan-tam.paragraph: With guests at the center of everything, we constantly strive to deliver the fullest “Home” experience — from the food to the service.

intro.heading: The Home's Story
paragraphs: Hello from The Home,

Welcome to a journey exploring Vietnam's specialty map with The Home, on an authentic Italian pizza base — every slice carries the mark of a Vietnamese region, where geography, climate, soil, and culture meet to shape its own distinct ingredients and flavors. From the belief that Vietnamese cuisine is rich enough to step onto the world stage, The Home holds firmly to its mission: drawing the Vietnamese Specialty Pizza Map.

For The Home, that journey began with something wonderfully simple: in a small kitchen on a hilltop in Sapa one winter afternoon in 2016, our Owner and Head Chef was struck by an unexpected harmony — salty, sour, the fragrant herbs of the Northwest, and the distinctly sweet, earthy taste of H'Mong duck. In the cool mountain air, that flavor sparked a new inspiration, and in that moment, The Home found its own path. The idea for H'Mong Duck Pizza was born — the starting milestone of The Home Pizza's journey to create Vietnamese specialty pizzas. On that journey of bringing regional specialties onto a pizza base, you and The Home keep writing together the dream of spreading Vietnamese culture through familiar flavors.
When you're at The Home, just make yourself at home!

phuQuoc.heading: The Home Pizza Signature Phu Quoc
phuQuoc.heroAlt: Dining room and bar at The Home Pizza Signature Phu Quoc
paragraphs: In 2019, the first The Home Pizza restaurant was born in Phu Quoc, carrying a vision to share Western culinary culture through the spirit of Vietnamese specialty cuisine. Five years later, that journey continues in a new form. Inspired by the idea of "coming home", The Home Pizza Signature was created in 2024 with the goal of recreating a dining space beneath the roof of a traditional three-room Vietnamese house, expressed through a modern design language and the feeling of being "as natural as home".

From that spirit, a rustic red brick wall highlights the open kitchen in the front room, welcoming guests with smiles from The Home's chefs as soon as they step inside. In the front yard is a cooling garden, where areca palms rise toward the sun, bamboo rustles in the breeze, and starfruit trees bring a familiar countryside sweetness. Vietnamese families have long planted areca palms at the front of the house as a hospitable greeting, kept starfruit trees for the gentle sweetness of the home garden, and let bamboo whisper by the veranda as a symbol of shelter and resilience. The Home brings those familiar forms into its garden so guests can touch that sense of belonging completely.

Alongside them are herbs cared for by The Home's own people, letting a gentle fragrance drift through the space and creating an easy, unhurried place to enjoy Vietnamese Specialty Pizza with loved ones.
A shared space has always been central to Vietnamese community life. That is why The Home gives the whole front yard to gatherings, making family meals feel fuller and warmer.

Stepping into the main house, guests find a cozy dining space and a modern bar opening under a warm, just-right glow. The main room is accented with woven rattan details, familiar enough and modern enough for guests to feel the Vietnamese specialty spirit more completely.

Under the shade of trees, or inside the warm dining room, there is a fresh hot Vietnamese Specialty Pizza, a glowing kitchen, and The Home's people welcoming you with a familiar smile. Everything is prepared neatly and thoughtfully so you can sit down naturally and feel at home.
In the lively center of the island, The Home Pizza Signature welcomes you "home" into a familiar and cozy space. Make yourself at home!
